description: Keep Renovate's PR count low and readable, for every e-llabo repository (inherited org-wide through github>e-llabo/.github): one weekly PR per repo for all non-major updates, every major update as its own PR opened at the next run, at most 5 open Renovate PRs per repo. Security fixes are not grouped, not scheduled and not counted against the PR limits (Renovate's vulnerabilityAlerts defaults). npm releases wait 3 days before they are proposed.

packageRules.description: Every minor, patch, digest and pin update in ONE weekly PR per repository. A superset of group:allNonMajor, which covers minor and patch only. Lock file maintenance and replacements are never grouped by Renovate, so they are not listed. The weekly window is 6 hours because the Mend app runs each repository only every ~4 hours. prPriority creates this PR before any waiting major when the concurrent limit is reached.

Every major update as its OWN PR (developer decision 2026-09-25), opened at the next run rather than on the weekly schedule. Minor, patch and digest updates stay grouped (weekly here; monthly for the platform groups in default.json). Exception on purpose: packages that must move together (Renovate's monorepo groups from config:recommended, e.g. react + react-dom, or upload/download-artifact) share one major PR.
